zh: 正在为<color=#FFC600>{action}</color>重新绑定，当前按键：<color=#FFC600>{key}</color>\n请按任意键设置新按键\n提示：如果{key}已被其他操作使用，或者修改的按键为WASD或方向键（↑↓←→）此次更改将不会应用
en: Rebinding for <color=#FFC600>{action}</color>, current key: <color=#FFC600>{key}</color>\nPress any key to set a new key\nTip: If {key} is already used by another action, or if the key being changed is WASD or the arrow keys (↑↓←→), this change will not be applied

zh: ·爬六层楼差点要命，在五楼还差点撞见主任
en: · Climbing six flights nearly killed me; I almost ran into the dean on the fifth floor.

zh: ·我决定用石头卡住铁门，要是被风刮得锁上就完了
en: · I decided to wedge the iron door with a rock—if the wind blows it shut and it locks, I’m done for.

zh: ·既然上来了，先跟着脚印去前面那个<color=#FFC600>告示牌</color>看看吧
en: · Since I’m up here, let’s follow the footprints and check that <color=#FFC600>notice board</color> up ahead.

zh: 终于安全了！我决定把这片天台好好探索一遍：
en: Finally safe! I’ve decided to thoroughly explore this rooftop:

zh: ·左侧的<color=#FFC600>草甸</color>总让我觉得熟悉
en: · The <color=#FFC600>meadow</color> on the left always feels familiar

zh: ·三盆<color=#FFC600>盆栽</color>的长势完全不一样，真让人好奇
en: · The three <color=#FFC600>potted plants</color> are growing completely differently—it really makes me curious

zh: ·旁边的<color=#FFC600>保洁工具和除草剂</color>...这个组合让人有些在意
en: · The nearby <color=#FFC600>cleaning tools and herbicide</color>... that combination is a bit concerning
